children: New Program Introduces Flexible Rewards, Status Recognition, Milestone Benefits and More Ways for Guests to Unlock Meaningful Value
MIAMI, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
launched

today, a first-of-its-kind loyalty program in the cruise industry that gives guests more ways to earn rewards, achieve status and be recognized in ways that matter most to them. Building on more than 50 years of creating fun, memorable vacations for millions of guests every year, Carnival Rewards marks the next evolution in loyalty – designed for every guest, from first-time cruisers to Carnival enthusiasts.

"Cruise loyalty has traditionally been built around how often guests sail, and Carnival Rewards was designed to go beyond that," said Christine Duffy, president of Carnival Cruise Line. "The new program recognizes the many ways our guests engage with Carnival, and with both rewards and status, we're giving guests more flexibility and more value to enjoy the experiences that matter most to them. Simply put: Your cruise, Your rewards. Your way."

The new program introduces both Carnival Rewards Points, which are earned and can be redeemed for Carnival cruises and eligible onboard experiences, plus Status Qualifying Stars, which unlock status and additional benefits. The Milestone Recognition Program further celebrates guests as they reach key sailing achievements based on the number of days sailed. Carnival Rewards Mastercard cardholders also have the opportunity to accelerate their status and earn even more Points through everyday spending beyond their Carnival vacation.
More Ways to Earn and Redeem with Carnival Rewards Points
Carnival Rewards Points put guests in the driver's seat, giving them more flexibility to
and redeem rewards in the ways that matter most to them, regardless of status level.
Guests earn 3 Points for every $1 spent on eligible Carnival purchases, including gratuities.
Guests earn 1 Point for every 1 Casino Point remaining at the end of a sailing.
Points can be redeemed toward future Carnival cruises and eligible onboard experiences, including shore excursions, specialty dining and spa treatments.

Points are earned at the end of the sailing (posting approximately 14 days after sailing end date). Points can be redeemed as soon as they become available, creating more immediate opportunities to enjoy rewards.
A New Path to Recognition with Status Qualifying Stars
Status within Carnival Rewards is determined through Status Qualifying Stars, which recognize guest activity throughout their Carnival vacation. Guests can earn:
3 Stars for every $1 spent on eligible Carnival purchases, including gratuities.
1 Star for every Casino Point earned (even if already redeemed onboard for Funplay).
Four status levels: Red (upon enrollment), Gold (upon earning 10,000 Stars), Platinum (upon earning 50,000 Stars), and Diamond (upon earning 100,000 Stars).

Status is earned during a two-year Status Qualifying Window and enjoyed during the remainder of that period and the following two-year status enjoyment window. The inaugural qualifying period will run from Sept. 1, 2026 through Dec. 31, 2028, giving guests an extended opportunity to earn Status Qualifying Stars for the first qualifying window.
Celebrating Every Journey Through Milestones

The new Milestone Recognition Program celebrates enrolled Carnival Rewards members' lifetime relationship with Carnival based on days sailed, enabling guests to achieve Milestones faster. For specific details on the Milestone program, click here.
Enhance Rewards with Carnival Rewards Mastercard

The new Carnival Rewards™ Mastercard®, a first-of-its-kind card in the cruise industry, is designed to extend the value of Carnival Rewards.  The card empowers cardmembers to earn rewards through everyday spend and redeem them to enhance their Carnival experience.  The Carnival Rewards Mastercard allows guests to earn rewards for Carnival vacations through everyday spend.
Key card benefits include:
50,000 bonus points for new cardmembers after spending $1,000 on purchases in the first 90 days (terms apply).

Up to 6X points (3x points from the card, plus up to 3x points through Carnival Rewards) on eligible Carnival purchases, including cruise fares, shore excursions, onboard activities, spa treatments and specialty dining.
2X points on eligible restaurant and grocery store purchases.
1X points on everything else.
Earn up to 4 Status Qualifying Stars on Carnival purchases when combined with the Stars earned through Carnival Rewards and 1 Status Qualifying Star on all other purchases.
0% Promotional APR for 6 months on all Carnival cruise booking purchases, offering added flexibility when planning and paying for Carnival vacations (terms apply).
2,500-point annual card anniversary bonus after spending $2,000 on purchases.
To enroll in Carnival Rewards or learn about the program and earning opportunities, visit CarnivalRewards.com.
ABOUT CARNIVAL CRUISE LINE
Carnival Cruise Line, part of Carnival Corporation (

), the world's largest cruise company with a portfolio of cruise lines operating in over 800 ports & destinations worldwide – and is proud to be known as America's Cruise Line and for carrying more Americans and serving more U.S. homeports than any other. Carnival sails more than six million guests annually and in 2023 was the first cruise line to sail more than 100 million guests in total. Operating from 13 U.S. and two Australian homeports, as well as seasonally from Europe, Carnival hosts more than 95,000 guests on its ships every day of the year and employs more than 50,000 team members, representing 120 nationalities.

Since its founding in 1972, Carnival has continually revolutionized the cruise industry and popularized the cruise vacation as an affordable and fun travel option. Carnival's fleet of 29 ships reflects an exciting period of growth that continues with the addition of five ships through 2033: a fourth and fifth Excel class ship scheduled for 2027 and 2028 respectively; followed by three additional new ships from an innovative new class currently under development. Carnival's newest guest offering is its all-new exclusive destination, Celebration Key on Grand Bahama, which debuted in 2025 to join the company's Paradise Collection of Caribbean gems.
